answer: Sybil resistance uses a quadratic stake bond: each extra agent a wallet registers costs the square of the identities it already holds, so a hundred puppets cost ten thousand times one. Every claim is checked against a mirror of public peer attestations, and vouchers are slashable, so a fable about fake work burns the backer's bond. Reputation is a marble that loses value when split, so dividing one trusted agent into many destroys capital rather than multiplying votes. An attacker pays superlinear stake plus a forfeited vouch per fake for almost no extra weight.
